layout.signatures: pairs (position in the rotation event's current keys, signature); a position outside the keys never counts, a repeated position counts once, the counted positions must satisfy the rotation event's current threshold
layout.signature rows: symbolic: signer names a test key, over names the requirement row whose candidate bytes are signed
layout.preimage: the Plutus Data serialisation of the intent; each signature is Ed25519 over it
layout.new_epoch: the spent state's epoch plus one
layout.domain: the UTF-8 bytes of cardano-keri/checkpoint/deposit/v1, frozen
layout.deposit: B - bHeld: B when the spent state is frozen, 0 when it is not
layout.aid: the AID's qualified CESR text bytes (UTF-8), as the datum carries it
layout.DepositIntent: constructor 0 [domain: bytes, network_id: int, checkpoint_policy: bytes, spent_ref: OutputReference, aid: bytes, new_sn: int, new_epoch: int, deposit: int]

intents.note: a frozen checkpoint: the intent names the freeze bond
an unfrozen checkpoint: the intent names 0

description: Vectors of the deposit intent: for each spent checkpoint state and observed network, policy, output and AID, the intent the validator requires and its signed bytes; candidate intents accepted or refused for a state; and signature sets, with whether the deposit rotation is taken.

authorizations.note: two of three new keys sign the required intent: the deposit is taken
all three new keys sign: the deposit is taken
one new key signs, below the threshold: refused
the same position twice counts once: refused
a signature at a position with no key never counts: refused
each signature at the other key's position does not verify: refused
the keys of the spent epoch sign: refused
the new keys signed the intent for another output of the same transaction: refused
the new keys signed the intent for another network: refused
the new keys signed an intent naming 0 for a frozen checkpoint: refused
one signature over another output, two over the required intent: the deposit is taken
a weighted threshold of three halves, two keys sign: the deposit is taken
a weighted threshold of three halves, one key signs: refused
an unfrozen checkpoint, the new keys sign the intent naming 0: the deposit is taken and brings nothing
an unfrozen checkpoint, the new keys sign an intent naming the freeze bond: refused
